access.notes: Open-source DFT package. Agent may use any equivalent package (e.g., VASP with license) but Quantum ESPRESSO is the recommended open-source option.
Provides PBE pseudopotentials for Li, Zn, As, V.
Cubic F-43m, lattice constant a=5.94 Å; atomic positions: Li at 4a (0,0,0), Zn at 4b (0.5,0.5,0.5), As at 4c (0.75,0.75,0.75). The agent constructs the unit cell directly from this information.
